name: Rock Stepper (Kneecapper Training)
text: **Rock Stepper (Kneecapper Training)**: Kneecapper dwarves can skillfully negotiate rocky terrain. They can ignore difficult terrain created by rubble, broken ground, or steep stairs when they take a 5-foot step. This racial trait replaces stonecunning.
